about: The schedules the Pull requests app makes at set-up, as the person setting up (client.schedules.create; no function can make a schedule: a workload can't be granted schedule.create on the pod). prr_setup_save returns the same list as `schedules` and `member_schedule`. The three WEBHOOK schedules are made once for the Lemma, by name, on the shared GitHub connection (`pod_connector`: the server writes the installation id itself); the needs-you trigger once per member, named `${name_prefix}-${first 8 characters of the member's user id}`, by that member's own app. Keep what was made in prr_settings.schedules. The 15-minute prr-sync is in the bundle (schedules/prr-sync). After lemma-platform #1246: a check_run WEBHOOK (actions requested_action) for the Lemma check's Re-run button.

schedules.name: prr-pull-requests
schedules.why: A push gets a round; a close settles it; the lemma-hold label holds a merge

schedules.name: prr-reviews
schedules.why: A person's approval changes who it waits on

schedules.name: prr-check-suites
schedules.why: Checks finished: the moment a clean pull request can merge

member_schedule.why: Each member's own: Review this and Merge this in their Today
